id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying syncs whose host resolves to an internal ip

review.posthog_relevance: Adds an internal/private IP address classification to the warehouse connector's non-retryable error handling, preventing unnecessary retry loops for permanent connectivity failures and including a diagnostic message for users.
review.reason: The change adds a specific, bounded improvement to warehouse ingestion reliability. P1.F1.H1 introduces a new entry in the `get_non_retryable_errors` dictionary, explicitly classifying internal/private IP resolution failures as permanent and non-retryable, accompanied by a user-facing diagnostic message. P1.F2.H1 provides a corresponding test case to verify this classification, and
review.uncertainty: The score relies on the assumption that this warehouse connector is actively used and that distinguishing retryable from non-retryable errors is a relevant reliability concern. The benefit is demonstrated by the implementation and test, not by observed production metrics.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new non-retryable error classification for internal/private IP addresses in Metabase warehouse source, alongside existing DNS resolution failure. The error message is added to the `get_non_retryable_errors` dictionary, and a comment explains the SSRF guard context.
observations.code_quote: "internal or private IP address": "The Metabase Instance URL resolves to an internal or private IP address. Use your instance's public URL, then reconnect.",
observations.posthog_connection: This prevents repeated retry attempts when the warehouse connector resolves to an internal/private IP, which is a permanent failure until the customer updates their configuration. This could reduce unnecessary retry traffic and help users diagnose connectivity issues faster.

observations.behavior: Adds a test case that explicitly checks the classification of the internal IP error message as non-retryable, using mocked dependencies and the real `_is_host_safe` implementation.
observations.posthog_connection: This test ensures that the classification of internal IP failures remains consistent and does not drift, supporting reliability of the retry behavior.
